pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Fixes a serious bug in backup retention: backups were sorted by folder name, so after a version-number digit change the launcher could delete its newest backups the moment they were created while keeping older ones — exactly the backups a rollback would need. Retention now sorts by timestamp. Also fixes a case where a failed launcher self-update download could still show "Update complete" (the pack result and the launcher-download result are now reported separately and honestly). Visually, the main Update/Play decision button is now a blue glass pill in the Apple system-blue style; nothing about how updating, Play, or Settings work has changed.
